statement: There are exactly 620 irreducible rational degree-4 plane curves through 11 general points.

answer.qualification: Irreducible rational quartics; reducible auxiliary count675 excluded.

source.location: Theorem 1.6, equation (1.5), journal p. 1458; Example 1.7 and Figure 1, p. 1459

origin.inheritance_basis: Set d=4 and g=0 in Theorem 1.6. Example 1.7 gives this value.

notes: Count geometric irreducible curves. For general points the solutions are distinct; reducible auxiliary counts are excluded.
